purpose: Execute a leakage-controlled, laboratory-anchor-held-out, nested and measurement-batch-clustered analysis on the seven-accession intersection frozen by T249 from four public paper/data source lineages.

target_universe.availability_rule: A common target contributes only when the audited source map records a finite strictly positive author value; blank, explicit zero and NA states remain missing.

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the release-fixed sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on amino-acid composition features only
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.cluster: held-out measurement batch; no donor independence is inferred from laboratory count
uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: Report measurement-batch count and avoid donor-level effective-n claims.

negative_control.alpha_policy: hold the observed nested-selected full-model alpha fixed within each outer fold

claim_boundary: This is an exploratory four-source strict-common-target portability analysis. It improves paper-data source compatibility and executes real models, but it does not establish four independent biological cohorts, donor-level generalization, evaluator lockbox performance, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
